name: auto-sprite-studio
description: Codex-native AI sprite sheet generation and alignment workflow.

interface.shortDescription: Generate, slice, align, and export 2D sprite sheets in Codex.
interface.longDescription: Auto Sprite Studio provides a Codex-native workflow for GPT Image generated 2D game sprites: generate a character sheet, remove chroma-key backgrounds, detect frame drift, align frames by bottom-center foot anchors, and export normalized PNG sheets plus metadata.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Auto Sprite Studio to generate or normalize a 4-direction walking sprite sheet.
